start: Owner on 'Your web page', page published and not taken down

steps.action: Tap 'Copy link' in the status card
must_not: The toast shown when nothing was copied
A link to a different address than the one on the card
A panel address, a login link or a key inside the link

start: Owner on 'Your web page', page published

user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab with the ready line 'See the fees, timings and photos of <gym name>: https://join.mettleup.fit/<address>' and asks who to send it to
must_not: A message sent without the owner choosing a person
A number filled in for him
The gym name broken by special letters

start: Owner on 'Your web page', sharing cannot work

steps.action: Open the screen when the page is saved but not published, or taken down by MettleUp
user_sees: Only 'See your page' in the status card; no 'Copy link', no 'Share on WhatsApp'
must_not: A share button for a page visitors cannot open

steps.action: Tap 'Copy link' in a browser that refuses copying
user_sees: Nothing at all: no toast, no words (WebPage.tsx:569-575). Finding FN-A5-panel-screens-2-4-01
must_not: The owner believing the link was copied

start: Owner, page published and its link already sent to people

steps.action: Untick 'Show my page to visitors', tap 'Save'
user_sees: Status 'Saved, not published. Visitors cannot see it.'
must_not: The shared link still showing the page

steps.action: Tick it again, tap 'Save and publish'
user_sees: Share buttons are back with the same address
must_not: A new address, so old links and printed QR codes stop working

start: Owner about to share the page

steps.action: Read the ready WhatsApp line before sending
user_sees: Only the gym's name and the public page address
must_not: A member's name, a phone number or a join code in the line
